No option can be put forward yet, because the model could not test your **monthly churn <4%** limit.

- The comparison held up under the tested changes, but that robustness applies only to the model’s MRR comparison—not to compliance with the churn constraint.
- It also assumes that maximising MRR is the goal; the £20k/month threshold could not be evaluated because the model lacks a current MRR baseline in the required frame.
- The comparison is most sensitive to **Pro subscriber count**, an Olumi-generated estimate rather than a user-supplied figure. Its investigation priority is not established from this result alone.
